title: Efficient Autonomous Navigation in Dynamic Environments: Algorithm Evaluation and Multi-Robot Coordination
authors: M. S. S. M; N. A. Wahab; M. S. A. Mahmud; H. Alqaraghuli; E. Samsuria; M. Z. Romdlony
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
